ready_probe:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
r=Path.home()/'sponge-sim/pi3b_600mhz_swapguard_v2/runs/qa_c_disconnect_01'
p=r/'qa_ready.json'
if p.exists():
 d=json.loads(p.read_text())
 x=subprocess.run(['systemctl','show','sponge-pi3b-swapguard-v2.service','-p','MainPID','-p','InvocationID','-p','ActiveState'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 f=dict(l.split('=',1) for l in x.stdout.splitlines())
 assert f['ActiveState']=='active' and int(f['MainPID'])==d['pid'] and f['InvocationID']==d['invocation_id']
 print(json.dumps(dict(ready=d,unit=f)))
else:print('null')
